nodes.summary: There is a finite set $V \subseteq \mathbb{Q}^3$ such that for every $v = (\alpha, \beta, \gamma) \in \mathbb{Z}^3$ the following are equivalent: every state $(x, y)$ of the shadow Markoff tree of $v$, the tree of the initial triple $(1 + \alpha\varepsilon, 1 + \beta\varepsilon, 1 + \gamma\varepsilon)$ with $\varepsilon^2 = 0$, has all coordinates of its classical part $x$ and of its shadow part $y$ nonnegative;…
nodes.title: Nonnegativity on a shadow Markoff tree is governed by finitely many points

nodes.summary: Number the positions $0, 1, 2$ and write a state as $(x \mid y)$, with classical part $x \in \mathbb{Q}^3$ and shadow part $y \in \mathbb{Q}^3$. The initial triple $(1, 1, 1 + \varepsilon)$, where $\varepsilon^2 = 0$, has shadow part $(0, 0, 1)$ (the paper's vertex $(0:0:1)$) and is the state $(1, 1, 1 \mid 0, 0, 1)$. Its shadow Markoff mutation at position $0$ is $(2, 1, 1 \mid 2, 0, 1)$, and the mutation of that…
nodes.title: The first two mutations in the tree of the vertex $(0:0:1)$

nodes.summary: A state is a pair $(x, y)$ of a classical part $x \in \mathbb{Q}^3$ and a shadow part $y \in \mathbb{Q}^3$, with coordinates indexed by the positions $0, 1, 2$. The shadow Markoff mutation at position $i$ replaces $x_i$ by $x_i' = \bigl(\sum_{j \ne i} x_j^2\bigr) / x_i$ and $y_i$ by $\bigl(-x_i' y_i + 2 \sum_{j \ne i} x_j y_j\bigr) / x_i$, and leaves every other coordinate of $x$ and $y$ unchanged.
nodes.title: Shadow Markoff mutation

nodes.summary: For $v = (\alpha, \beta, \gamma) \in \mathbb{Z}^3$, the initial triple with shadow part $v$ is $(1 + \alpha\varepsilon, 1 + \beta\varepsilon, 1 + \gamma\varepsilon)$, where $\varepsilon^2 = 0$. It is stored as the state $(x, y)$ with classical part $x = (1, 1, 1) \in \mathbb{Q}^3$ and shadow part $y = (\alpha, \beta, \gamma) \in \mathbb{Q}^3$.
nodes.title: Initial triple of a shadow Markoff tree

nodes.summary: Fix $v \in \mathbb{Z}^3$ and let $r$ be the initial triple with shadow part $v$, viewed as a state (a pair of a classical part and a shadow part, both in $\mathbb{Q}^3$, with coordinates indexed by the positions $0, 1, 2$). The lower nodes of the shadow Markoff tree of $v$ are pairs $(s, l)$ of a state $s$ and a position $l$, the position mutated last. They are defined inductively: the state obtained from $r$ by…
nodes.title: Lower nodes of a shadow Markoff tree

nodes.summary: In the shadow Markoff tree of $v = (1, 1, 1)$, the tree of the initial triple $(1 + \varepsilon, 1 + \varepsilon, 1 + \varepsilon)$ with $\varepsilon^2 = 0$, every solution $(x, y)$ has shadow part $y$ equal to its classical part $x$.
nodes.title: Shadow parts equal classical parts when $v = (1, 1, 1)$

nodes.summary: For $v \in \mathbb{Z}^3$, the shadow Markoff tree of $v$ is the set of states $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Q}^3 \times \mathbb{Q}^3$ (classical part $x$, shadow part $y$) consisting of the initial triple $r$ with shadow part $v$, the shadow Markoff mutation of $r$ at position $0$, and the state $s$ of every lower node $(s, l)$ of the shadow Markoff tree of $v$.
nodes.title: Shadow Markoff tree

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
